$comment: This site's half of the cross-repository contract, and it is data only.
Zero-custom-UI: this site ships no stylesheet. The DS stylesheet is the only
styling entry point, enforced by scripts/check-ui-compliance.mjs (UI001).
The gates below stay listed and run; their sheet floors are zero because
there is no sheet left to read. The laws themselves are in
`@nanisoft/prism-ui/gates` and version with the pinned package, so the
generation declared below is the generation that pin's kit carries.
gateKit 2 (Prism 1.8). The view-only gate is not named, and the omission is
the decision: app/opengraph-image.tsx renders an ImageResponse, whose SVG
surface the one stylesheet cannot reach, so its inline style is the only
way that image can be drawn at all. A gate this site cannot meet without
deleting its own link-preview image is not a gate it can hold yet; the day
the catalogue publishes a drawn OG surface, that file goes and this site
names the gate in the same change.
